editorial: When darkness curdles into a hunting nightmare, you cannot look away. What sets this horror thriller apart is its unsettling rule, the dead are not passive avatars but relentless predators. The claustrophobic soundscape turns every footstep into a heartbeat, turning city streets into a metronome of terror. You’ll find it compelling if you crave slow-burn dread that escalates with each frame.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
